# Help us complete JEM

## Three steps

::: {.fragment}
**1. Pick a prompt.** Join the Discord, or sign in at [friedso.com/apps/jem](https://friedso.com/apps/jem/) and take a prompt that fits your token budget.
:::

::: {.fragment}
**2. Ask your model.** Copy the prompt. Download the file it returns.
:::

::: {.fragment}
**3. Send the file back.** Upload it through the Google Form, post it in Discord, or send it by email.
:::

LETI — Law, Engineering and Technology for India

![Discord QR code](assets/deck/image14.png){.discord-qr}

::: {.notes}
Only if time permits. Budget 3 minutes. This is the last block before the close, and the talk should finish at 20 minutes.

Agriya or Prajna can run the contribution path live if the clock allows. Otherwise read the three steps and go to the team slide.
:::
